Report exceptions (e.g., delayed bags, damage, wrong routing) to the supervisor.
Collect the sorted outbound shipments and check the condition.
Prepare bags based on assigned delivery beats or given criteria, and bag if any dangerous goods separately as per SOP.
Seal the bag and label it with a barcode sticker and other labels.
Scan the barcode sticker or label on the bag.
Prioritise and move mail bags to the loading area, use MHE if required.
Inform of any damaged or suspicious shipments and assist in sampling inspection if required.
Hand over sorted mail for delivery, or Load and arrange the mail bags in the assigned truck.
